EC1: Hospitalization [AND] for acute decompensated HF within previous 30 days
EC2: Hospitalization for myocardial infarction [OR] or cardiac surgery within previous 90 days
EC3: Presence of a left ventricular assist device
EC7: Severe renal failure [AND] with estimated glomerular filtration rate <30 ml/min
EC8: Prior stroke [AND] with functional impairment or other severe, uncontrolled medical problems that may impair ability to participate in the study exams, based on medical history and review of medical records
EC9: Severe chronic insomnia, with reported usual sleep duration <4 hours
EC10: Severe daytime sleepiness, defined as Epworth Sleepiness Scale score 18 or higher or a report of falling asleep driving during the previous year, and deemed a safety risk by study physician
EC13: Smoking by subject or other person in the subject's bedroom, or other open flame in bedroom
EC14: Current use of a positive airway pressure device [OR] (including continuous [OR] or bi-level positive airway pressure [OR] or adaptive servo-ventilation) or supplemental oxygen therapy
